meta.title: Pokémon Pokopia – Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive - Nintendo Official Site for Canada
meta.description: A Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive Pokémon adventure. Play as Ditto, build a cozy world, and befriend Pokémon in this relaxing life-sim game.

modules.heading: Shape the world and build a cozy new life with Pokémon

modules.alt: Ditto's transformed into a human! The small eyes and wide smile still look a lot like Ditto.
Ditto is an adorable purple blob with small dots for eyes and a wide thin smile.

modules.heading: Play as a Ditto and build a new life with Pokémon—from the ground up!

content.value: With help from your Pokémon friends, rebuild a desolate world into a charming utopia, one step at a time.

modules.heading: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC

Pokémon Pokopia

asset.alt: Professor Tangrowth has a broken pair of glasses, a stick, and a TM on its head.

content.value: Pokémon and people once lived happily together
, but the world has withered and the humans are gone.
The only remaining resident is Professor Tangrowth, living alone in the wasteland.
After waking from a long slumber,
a peculiar Ditto decides to restore the desolate land using its transformation skills and its surprising new crafting abilities.

modules.text: Learn the moves of your fellow Pokémon to change the land, travel, and more!

Ditto, Charmander, Pichu, and Cubone gather around a campfire on the beach.

assets.alt: Ditto and Pokémon are standing in front of a log cabin as confetti falls.
Ditto naps on a beach sun chair. Slowpoke's napping on the pier while others have ice desserts.

content.value: Here are just a few of the unusual Pokémon you’ll meet.
A vital guide for you and all the Pokémon you meet.
An unusually pale Pikachu.
Moss has grown all over this Snorlax—how long has it been asleep?!
What a colorful chum! It looks like quite the prolific painter!
This Rotom inhabits a mini stereo. If you give it some CDs, it will liven things up with a variety of music.
This Greedent likes to store kitchen tools all over its body and treat everyone to its delicious dishes.

asset.alt: Ditto dives feet first under water with a bubble around their head.

content.value: The new underwater exploration update is available to everyone who has
Pokémon Pokopia
By learning Dive, Ditto can move around freely underwater! Explore towns in a new way—beneath the waves.
In order to learn Dive, you will need to complete the request “Raise the environment level!” in Bleak Beach. You will also need the ability to jump and to know the move Surf.

modules.heading: Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC

content.value: Meet additional characters, explore new areas, and more in the three-part
Pokémon Pokopia
Expansion Pass paid DLC.******
Expand your world with more areas to explore, Pokémon to meet, and items to decorate your homes with! The additional content from the
Pokémon Pokopia
Expansion Pass DLC will be released in three parts, but one purchase gets you access to everything as it's released.
Use the move Dive—an underwater exploration ability added in a free software update to the
Pokémon Pokopia
game—to visit the aquatic area of Bubbly Basin in Part One of the three-part
Pokémon Pokopia
Expansion Pass paid DLC! You’ll find additional furniture items, a new outfit for Ditto, and—of course—more Pokémon to meet.

assets.caption: The Pokémon Pokopia Bubbly Basin DLC plays and we see a Ditto walk toward the water's edge, learn Dive and explore under the water where they meet Popplio.

content.value: To access Bubbly Basin’s underwater gate, you must first learn Dive and complete the important request “Raise the environment level!” in Bleak Beach.

A wide shot of the underwater town of Bubbly Basin where new Pokémon await for Expansion Pass players.

content.value: Dress up your Pokémon pals—and yourself!
Look your best by wearing accessories with your Pokémon friends. Meet new friends and add some flair to your surroundings with new furniture and more Pokémon.
Learn more about Part 2 of the Pokémon Pokopia Expansion Pass paid DLC in this video.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100107421\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Play as a Ditto that has transformed to look like a human! Find and befriend your fellow Pokémon, carve out a life for yourself, and work together with Professor Tangrowth to build a town for everyone to live in. Learn the moves of your fellow Pokémon to change the land, such as Bulbasaur’s Leafage to make the wild grass grow. You can also use abilities to transform and navigate the world around you, such as crossing water with Lapras’s Surf.

As you work to help nature flourish, more Pokémon will appear for you to meet and learn from. You might even encounter a Legendary Pokémon!

Create habitats, cultivate crops, and more in a world with varied weather and real-time day and nights

Gather materials to create items and furniture, till the fields to grow crops and cook them into delicious meals, create habitats for the Pokémon you meet, take photos of fun moments, customize your hairstyle and clothing…there’s so much to do here! No need to rush, though—go at your own pace and enjoy the journey. With a real-time day and night cycle, varying weather, and other surprises, just taking a nap in your bed and letting time pass can be pretty relaxing.

As your town develops, your fellow Pokémon may also come to you with requests you can fulfill to solve their problems or make the town a more comfortable place to live in. Eventually, you’ll be able to build a nice big home of your own and invite Pokémon to visit. You can also invite up to three other players, via local wireless* or online**, to visit and hang out together—and each of them can bring a Pokémon along.

You can even invite a friend who doesn’t have the game—whether they are on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system or Nintendo Switch—by using GameShare***!

Learn the Dive move and build underwater in a free software update

Swim and expand your town underwater after learning a newly added move: Dive! In order to learn Dive, you will need to complete the request “Raise the environment level!” in Bleak Beach. You will also need the ability to jump and to know the move Surf.

Be on the lookout for scheduled in-game events

Mix up your routine by taking part in regularly held in-game events****! Fulfill event requirements to befriend Pokémon who visit your town, obtain event-themed furniture and other items, and more.
